study: Perturbation-Based Data Selection for Medical Question Answering
status: Preprint submitted to IEEE ICHI 2027; acceptance not asserted
initialization: raw checkpoint, fresh LoRA per branch, no answer-only warm-up

scoring.visibility: question and options; no candidate labels or auxiliary text used
scoring.entropy: restricted next-token softmax over legal leading-space option letters
scoring.intervention: final decoder block output, before model-level norm and LM head
scoring.full_pool_ablation: recompute coefficient over complete bank per dataset and seed; reuse across budgets

training.loss: final-answer target tokens only; explanations are input context
training.precision_rule: bfloat16 if supported, otherwise float16; historical resolved precision not retained

evaluation: question/options only; restricted next-letter scoring; no rationale input
historical_reproducibility: Model revision and environment were not fully pinned. Source/result hashes do not establish bitwise replication.
